notes.title: Thanks for your patience — launch is just around the corner! 🎮
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone! 👋[/p][p]We’re hard at work testing the game, hunting down bugs, and polishing every corner to make sure your upcoming experience is smooth and exciting.[/p][p]The release is coming very soon, and we can’t wait for you to dive into our world. 🌟[/p][p]If you haven’t added the game to your wishlist yet — now’s the perfect time! It’ll make sure you don’t miss the launch and helps support us in the final stretch.[/p][p]Thanks for sticking with us! 💛[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45043567/2fe08a5ea2b06a8251bb16fb8318055d0e9ca9d7.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: 🎮 Thanks for playing the demo! 🚀
notes.content:
We’ve just released the very first demo, and now we really want to hear from you!

💬 What did you enjoy?
🤔 What felt off or confusing?
🐞 Did you run into any bugs or issues?

👉 Drop your thoughts in the comments or start a discussion — every bit of feedback helps us make the game better!

Thanks so much for playing and supporting us early on! 💛
— The Dev Team
